args.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS robot_model_performance_summary AS
SELECT 
    rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS robot_quantity,
    AVG(ad.pathaccmmval) AS average_error,
    AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS average_speed,
    AVG(ps.qualitymeasureval) AS average_duration
FROM 
    robot_details rd
LEFT JOIN 
    actuation_data ad ON rd.botdetreg = ad.actdetref
LEFT JOIN 
    operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
LEFT JOIN 
    performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
GROUP BY 
    rd.modelseriesval;
